status: fixed before all stream-delay and network MPC results
mechanism: Per-party host:port files in pinned MP-SPDZ. Each party's own listening port is direct; all other peers route through task-owned loopback TCP relays. Both stream directions release received chunks at arrival+RTT/2. Separate receive/deadline-send tasks prevent serial sleep per chunk. No host network setting changes.
calibration: 22 sequential64-byte echoes per delay, first2 discarded; retain all20 RTTs. Check median>=0.9*target and <=target+max(15ms,0.25*target).
buffer: 128 queued64KiB chunks per direction; record high-water bytes and backpressure events. Any backpressure is a measured additional limitation, not silently unlimited bandwidth.
correctness: Zero-delay complete N2D64 state transition and query for eager/virtual kernels, full reference oracle
repetitions: One warmup plus3 balanced alternating repetitions per method/delay/benchmark; DIAG0. Timeout900seconds per attempt, preserve failures and logs.
scope: User-space stream-delay emulation with all five parties on one host; no physical WAN, packet loss or explicit bandwidth model. Small rekey size selected for bounded runtime before delay results; do not extrapolate it to real512-bit galleries. Cold trusted-owner input interface only; private client-output correctness tested separately.
metrics: Full VM/wall time, global communication, party0 rounds, maximum single-party RSS, relay controller CPU/bytes/queue, all party logs and source/config/input hashes.
